quests.title: Mutual Exchange

dialogue.t: Mi muhe mosi! Mi muhe mita, <color=#00E1FFFF>mita movo lata</color>!
Oh, it's hungry... Let's see what it wants, shall we?
It appears to want... some sort of meat? But I'm not sure what, exactly, so could you please check the handbook?
Mi mito nye. Ya zido mito, mi mito! Mi zido!
It said... it also doesn't know, but it knows someone else who knows. And it marked their location on the Map for us!

dialogue.sit: I think we got it wrong...

quests.description: You go with Ella Musk to communicate with the hilichurls. Perhaps this might be the start of a new friendship…?
